bias.zh: 反弹 · 重回 10 日均线上方，仍低于 $37.8–38.6

read.en: MP Materials rose 2.0% on Nov 12 to $37.45, trading $35.93–38.63 on heavy volume (1.47x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($36.76) and 10-day ($36.92) and below the 30-day ($40.44), 100-day ($47.85) and 200-day ($53.84), all falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 9, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 3 ($39.43), and RSI is 42.6.
read.zh: MP Materials 11月12日上涨 2.0%，收于 $37.45，盘中区间 $35.93–38.63，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.47 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$36.76）和 10 日均线（$36.92）上方，30 日（$40.44）、100 日（$47.85）和 200 日均线（$53.84）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月9日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月3日起看空（$39.43），RSI 为 42.6。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 10-day, now support with the 5-day; the $38.63 high faded and the close stayed under the $37.81 Jul 29 low. Resistance is $37.8–38.6, then $39.0–39.4 (Nov 4 high, SAR) and $40.4 (30-day). Support is $36.7–36.9 (5 and 10-day, Nov 11 low), then $35.6–35.9 and $33.8. A close above $38.6 would target $39.4–40.4; below $35.6, $33.8.

s.en: Nov 4 low $35.56; Nov 10 low $35.60; Nov 12 low $35.93
